L03_lognormal_adjusted_projection.derivation: Within-sex lognormal Cov(Xi,Xj)=mi*mj*(exp(Sigmaij)-1). Residualize saturated binary sex, then BMI via Schur complement. Age is independent of biomarkers conditional on sex. Pooled total covariance would give wrong adjusted projections.

HRS_truncated_Gamma_and_fixed_effects.static_assessment: Integration follows actual continuous uniform ages, normal CSES, categorical education and Gamma(shape=1/phi,scale=phi*mu). Truncated moment identity Q(shape+j,k/theta) multiplies the proper jth raw moment. Both programs have zero-conditional-mean subject and visit errors; random-effect covariance rounding cannot reverse population fixed coefficients. This does not prove the observed sign split is solely sampling noise or validate target biology.

source_only_age_profile_scalar_crosschec.assumptions: Normal within source age bins; requested equal broad-age-band mixture and uniform years; oldest >=70 source transferred to70–79. No clinical refit.
